description: Source code for a dynamic strings library (SDSLib) implementing null-terminated, binary-safe strings with various manipulation functions, including creation, duplication, concatenation, trimming, splitting, and formatting.

methods.name: sdsnewlen
methods.description: Creates a new dynamic string with specified content and length.

methods.name: sdsempty
methods.description: Creates an empty (zero-length) sds string with null terminator.

methods.name: sdsnew
methods.description: Creates a new sds string from a null-terminated C string.

methods.name: sdsdup
methods.description: Duplicates an existing sds string.

methods.name: sdsfree
methods.description: Frees an sds string.

methods.name: sdsupdatelen
methods.description: Updates the length of an sds string based on its current content.

methods.name: sdsclear
methods.description: Resets an sds string to empty, preserving buffer space.

methods.name: sdsMakeRoomFor
methods.description: Enlarges the free space at the end of an sds string.

methods.name: sdsRemoveFreeSpace
methods.description: Reallocates sds string to remove free space at the end.

methods.name: sdsAllocSize
methods.description: Returns total allocated size of an sds string.

methods.name: sdsIncrLen
methods.description: Increments or decrements the length of an sds string.

methods.name: sdsgrowzero
methods.description: Grows an sds string to a specified length, zero-filling new space.

methods.name: sdscatlen
methods.description: Appends binary-safe data to an sds string.

methods.name: sdscat
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated C string to an sds string.

methods.name: sdscatsds
methods.description: Appends one sds string to another.

methods.name: sdscpylen
methods.description: Replaces sds string content with binary-safe data.

methods.name: sdscpy
methods.description: Replaces sds string content with a null-terminated C string.

methods.name: sdsll2str
methods.description: Converts a long long to string, storing in provided buffer.

methods.name: sdsull2str
methods.description: Converts an unsigned long long to string, storing in provided buffer.

methods.name: sdsfromlonglong
methods.description: Creates an sds string from a long long value.

methods.name: sdscatvprintf
methods.description: Appends formatted string using va_list to an sds string.

methods.name: sdscatprintf
methods.description: Appends formatted string to an sds string.

methods.name: sdscatfmt
methods.description: Appends formatted string with limited format specifiers for performance.

methods.name: sdstrim
methods.description: Trims characters from both ends of an sds string.

methods.name: sdsrange
methods.description: Extracts a substring from an sds string based on start and end indices.

methods.name: sdstolower
methods.description: Converts all characters in an sds string to lowercase.

methods.name: sdstoupper
methods.description: Converts all characters in an sds string to uppercase.

methods.name: sdscmp
methods.description: Compares two sds strings lexicographically.

methods.name: sdssplitlen
methods.description: Splits a binary-safe string into tokens based on a separator.

methods.name: sdsfreesplitres
methods.description: Frees array of tokens produced by sdssplitlen.

methods.name: sdscatrepr
methods.description: Appends an escaped string representation of data.

methods.name: sdssplitargs
methods.description: Splits a line into arguments considering quotes and escapes.

methods.name: sdsmapchars
methods.description: Replaces characters in an sds string based on from-to mapping.

methods.name: sdsjoin
methods.description: Joins array of C strings with a separator into an sds string.
